description: Find the places this workspace can publish to — connected YouTube channels and custom RTMP endpoints — and their ids, which is what add_stream_destination needs. Check `status`: only an `active` destination can carry a stream; `needs_reauth` and `revoked` mean the YouTube connection must be re-consented (start_youtube_connection) before a stream using it will start. Returns a page of rows (id, name, kind, status, rtmpURL, ytChannelTitleCached, archivedAt, lastUsedAt, createdAt) plus nextCursor and total.

after.description: The `nextCursor` from a previous page of this same tool.

first.description: How many rows to return on this page; 20 when omitted.

id.description: Look up a single destination by id (dest_...).

kind.description: Filter by kind: a connected YouTube channel, or a custom RTMP endpoint.

name.description: Case-insensitive substring to match destination names.

sort.description: Order rows by creation time; newest first when omitted.

status.description: Only destinations in this state. Streams publish only to active ones; needs_reauth and revoked ones need start_youtube_connection again.

name: list_destinations

hasMore.description: Whether there is a next page.

nextCursor.description: Pass back as `after` for the next page; null when this is the last page.

total.description: Total matching records, not just this page.

code.description: Stable — branch on it: INVALID_INPUT, REVISION_REQUIRED, STALE_PUBLISH, CONFIRM_REQUIRED, UNAVAILABLE, …

currentRevision.description: CONFLICT: the revision it has now

detail.description: What is wrong, in a sentence

errors.description: Each problem, when a check refused it

title: List destinations
